data.one_liner: A collapsible Material Design sidebar for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable sidebar navigation component that can collapse and expand. Supports multi-level menus, alert badges, smooth animations, and RTL languages.
use_when: You need a collapsible sidebar navigation drawer for desktop, web, or mobile apps.
You want pre-built customizable tile widgets with support for icons, text, and badges.
avoid_when: You need a standard bottom navigation bar or top tab bar.
You require complex navigation routing managed entirely outside of custom widget trees.
strengths: Supports multi-level menus and alert badges.
Smooth animations with customizable duration and curves.
Supports both LTR and RTL languages.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of README examples and parameters table.
Not documented for complex state-driven deep routing.
data.minimal_example:
CollapsibleSidebar(
  items: _items,
  avatarImg: _avatarImg,
  title: 'John Smith',
  body: _body(size, context),
)
